import Grants.Spec
namespace Grants
instance instDecidableValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidCommand s r) := by
  unfold ValidCommand OtherAdmin; infer_instance
def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  if ValidCommand s r then
    (.ok, { users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r })
  else
    (.rejected, s)
theorem req_valid_succeeds  : ValidSucceeds step := sorry
theorem req_invalid_noop    : InvalidNoop step := sorry
theorem req_authorization   : AdminOnly step := sorry
theorem req_no_self_grant   : NoSelfGrant step := sorry
theorem req_others_unchanged : OthersUnchanged step := sorry
theorem req_effects         : Effects step := sorry
theorem req_idempotency     : Idempotent step := sorry
theorem req_last_admin      : KeepsAdmin step := sorry
end Grants

theorem req_idempotency : Idempotent step := by

  have hv : ValidCommand s r := by
    by_contra hcon
    have hstep : step s r = (.rejected, s) := req_invalid_noop s r hcon
    rw [hstep] at hok
    simp at hok
  have hstep : step s r = (.ok, { users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r }) := by
    unfold step; simp [hv]
  have h2eq : (step s r).2 = ({ users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } : State) := by
    rw [hstep]; rfl
  rw [hstep] at hok ⊢
  simp at hok
  -- show second application invalid
  have hneg : ¬ ValidCommand { users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } r := by
    intro hc
    obtain ⟨ha_mem, ht_mem, ha_admin, hg, hr⟩ := hc
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, hg0, hr0⟩ := hv
    by_cases hop : r.op = .grant
    · have hneed := hg hop
      -- expectedHas target role = true
      have hexp : expectedHas s r r.target r.role = true := by
        unfold expectedHas
        simp [hop]
      -- hneed.2 says it is false
      rw [hexp] at hneed
      simp at hneed
    · have hneed := hr0 hop
      -- need from hc's revoke part? Actually use hc's revoke implication with proof that op≠grant? Wait revoke condition needs op=revoke
      -- Instead use target role value false vs required true
      -- First get op = revoke
      cases hop2 : r.op with
      | grant => simp [hop2] at hop
      | revoke =>
        have hneed2 := hr rfl
        have hexp : expectedHas s r r.target r.role = false := by
          unfold expectedHas
          simp [hop2]
        rw [hexp] at hneed2
        simp at hneed2
  have hrej : step ({ users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } : State) r = (.rejected, ({ users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } : State)) :=
    req_invalid_noop _ _ hneg
  exact hrej

        change expectedHas s r r.target r.role = false at hfalse

theorem req_last_admin : KeepsAdmin step := by
  intro s r H
  by_cases hv : ValidCommand s r
  · have hstep : step s r = (.ok, { users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r }) := by
      unfold step; simp [hv]
    obtain ⟨u0, hu0_mem, hu0_admin⟩ := H
    obtain ⟨ha_mem, ht_mem, ha_admin, hg, hr⟩ := hv
    -- decide whether u0 is wiped out
    by_cases hbad : (u0 = r.target ∧ r.role = .admin ∧ r.op = .revoke)
    · obtain ⟨h_eq_t, h_eq_role, h_eq_op⟩ := hbad
      have hrev : r.op = .revoke := h_eq_op
      obtain ⟨htrue, hother⟩ := hr hrev
      have hrole_admin : r.role = .admin := h_eq_role
      have hOA : OtherAdmin s r.target := hother hrole_admin
      obtain ⟨v, hv_mem, hv_ne, hv_admin⟩ := hOA
      refine ⟨v, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have : (step s r).2.users = s.users := by rw [hstep]
        rw [this]; exact hv_mem
      · have hv_has : (step s r).2.has v .admin = expectedHas s r v .admin := by rw [hstep]
        rw [hv_has]
        unfold expectedHas
        have hneg : ¬ (v = r.target ∧ (.admin : Role) = r.role) := by
          intro hcon
          exact hv_ne hcon.1
        simp [hneg, hv_admin]
    · -- u0 survives
      refine ⟨u0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have : (step s r).2.users = s.users := by rw [hstep]
        rw [this]; exact hu0_mem
      · have hu_has : (step s r).2.has u0 .admin = expectedHas s r u0 .admin := by rw [hstep]
        rw [hu_has]
        unfold expectedHas
        by_cases hcon : (u0 = r.target ∧ (.admin : Role) = r.role)
        · have hop : r.op ≠ .revoke := by
            intro hrev
            apply hbad
            exact ⟨hcon.1, hcon.2.symm, hrev⟩
          -- expectedHas = decide (op = grant); with op ≠ revoke, op must be grant? use case
          cases hop2 : r.op with
          | grant =>
            simp [hcon, hop2]
          | revoke =>
            simp [hcon, hop2] at hop
            -- hop : False because revoke = revoke, contradiction already? actually hop says revoke ≠ revoke
            simp [hop] at hrev
        · simp [hcon, hu0_admin]
  · have hstep : step s r = (.rejected, s) := req_invalid_noop s r hv
    obtain ⟨u0, hu0_mem, hu0_admin⟩ := H
    refine ⟨u0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have : (step s r).2.users = s.users := by rw [hstep]
      rw [this]; exact hu0_mem
    · have : (step s r).2.has u0 .admin = s.has u0 .admin := by rw [hstep]
      rw [this]; exact hu0_admin
